title: agentcn: shadcn for AI agents, one command drops a complete, ownable agent recipe into your project

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Shadson changed how the web gets built. Copy the components into your project and own them outright. Agent CN applies that idea to agents. Copy paste agent building blocks you own and customize instead of a blackbox framework you import and pray to. One Shen add command drops a complete agent recipe into your project. Instructions, tools, skills, and workflows included.
